# get_isos_fit_for_raspa_folder { #mofography.raspa_helper.get_isos_fit_for_raspa_folder }

```python
raspa_helper.get_isos_fit_for_raspa_folder(path_to_folder, T, order)
```

Fit Legendre polynomials to RASPA energies and return isosteric heat vs loading.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type    | Description                                                | Default    |
|----------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| path_to_folder | string  | Path to the RASPA folder with all the output_*.data files  | _required_ |
| T              | float   | Temperature                                                | _required_ |
| order          | integer | Order of the Legendre polynomials to be used in regression | _required_ |
